newsitem.title: USA: Salomon CEO urges "fast track" for trade talk.
newsitem.headline: Salomon CEO urges "fast track" for trade talk.

text.p: The chief executive of Salomon Inc, said Tuesday that Congress should give the Administration "fast track" authority to negotiate trade treaties.

Testifying before the Ways & Means Trade Committee of the U.S. House of Representatives, Robert Denham said Congress should grant the Administration trade negotiating authority to ensure that the U.S. continues its political and economic role as the leader of international trade liberalization.
Denham said regional trade pacts, such as the South American Common Market of the South, anchored by Brazil and Argentina, are already being written without U.S. participation.

"Congress must show our partners that the United States is ready to move forward. This is why fast track authority is so essential," said Denham. "Without a signal from Congress, others will not take U.S. interest in market opening agreements seriously."
